segments.name: Consumer and Insurance
segments.description: Originates and services personal loans, auto finance loans, and credit cards, and provides optional credit and non-credit insurance products to nonprime consumers.
segments.evidence: At December 31, 2025, Consumer and Insurance ("C&I") was our only reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Nonprime consumer borrowers pay interest and certain fees on personal loans, auto finance loans, and credit cards, and customers pay for optional insurance and other products.
revenueModel.evidence: We track interest income, including certain fees earned on our finance receivables, and continually monitor the components that impact our yield.
